title: Clicking a time in your own draft shows it on the calendar before any event form
steps: Launch with -UseFakeData -UseFakeCalendar, open a conversation and press r
Type Could we meet tomorrow at 3pm? and click the underlined time
Click the Create event block, then press Cancel in the new event card
expected: The calendar opens on the right on tomorrow with 3 PM drawn as a Create event block, as for a time in a message; no form opens until the block is clicked. The card then opens over the day with Save and Cancel visible, and Cancel brings the block back.
